IS 5195 : 2024 Paper Stationery Items for Schools - Specification
ICS 87.080
ICS 87.080
CHD 14
CHD 14
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the requirements for the following paper stationery items, generally used in schools:
a) Exercise books (wire stitched);
b) Exercise books (bound);
c) Drawing exercise books (wire stitched);
d) Map exercise books (wire stitched);
e) Science practical notebooks (bound);
f) Examination answer books (wire stitched);
g) Register (wire stitched); and
h) Register (bound).
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards:
